title: Screening with Discrete Types and Discrete Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2510.20921v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study screening when both the agent's types and the contracts available to the principal are finite: Quantities and transfers are drawn from a finite integer grid, while marginal costs lie on a slightly off-set grid, with integer costs as a limit case. We compare two solution concepts, equilibrium and rationalizability. Since rationalizability does not feature an equilibrium tie-breaking convention, we analyze screening under weak and under strict incentives. We develop a discrete first-order approach and characterize the optimal menus for full-support log-concave beliefs. Optimal quantities need not be unique, but at most two adjacent quantities are optimal and multiplicity is a knife-edge case in beliefs. Our rationalizability solution concept, Delta-O rationalizability, restricts the principal's beliefs over types and requires her best replies to be robust to belief perturbations. translated_title: 离散类型与离散合同下的筛选问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究当代理人的类型与委托人可用的合同均为有限集合时的筛选问题：数量与转移支付取自一个有限整数网格，而边际成本位于一个略有偏移的网格上，整数成本则作为极限情形。我们比较了两种解概念——均衡与可理性化。由于可理性化不包含均衡中的平局打破惯例，我们分别分析了弱激励与严格激励下的筛选问题。我们发展了一种离散的一阶方法，并在满支撑的对数凹信念下刻画了最优菜单。最优数量未必唯一，但至多只有两个相邻数量可能是最优的，且多重性仅在信念处于刀锋情形时出现。我们所提出的可理性化解概念——Δ-O可理性化——对委托人关于类型的信念施加了限制，并要求其最优应对对信念扰动具有稳健性。两轮剔除即可得到解，且可理性化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文研究类型与合同均为离散有限情形下的筛选问题，发展出离散一阶方法刻画最优菜单结构，并提出Δ-O可理性化概念，在委托人信念受限且要求最优应对对信念扰动稳健的条件下给出两轮剔除即可得到的筛选解。
en_tdlr: This paper studies screening with finite discrete types and contracts, develops a discrete first-order approach to characterize optimal menus, and introduces Δ-O rationalizability—a solution concept restricting the principal's beliefs and requiring robust best replies—showing that two rounds of elimination suffice.
